name: Kaguya Hime
source:
A girl dressed in traditional Japanese clothing, she appears before those who are about to die. She has long since abandoned the name she went by from her days as a human, from the distant past.

[Translated from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2018/12/30/kasutera/]official website[/url]]
